# libogg Zephyr module glue.
#
# Sources come from lib/ogg (xiph/ogg submodule, currently v1.3.6).
# The library is just bitwise.c + framing.c; config_types.h is normally
# generated by autotools, here a fixed stdint-based version is provided
# in include/ogg.

if(CONFIG_OGG)

set(OGG_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../lib/ogg)

if(NOT EXISTS ${OGG_DIR}/include/ogg/ogg.h)
  message(FATAL_ERROR
    "lib/ogg submodule not checked out. Run: git submodule update --init")
endif()

zephyr_library_named(ogg)

# Public headers (#include <ogg/ogg.h>); our include/ dir shadows the
# generated config_types.h that os_types.h expects.
zephyr_include_directories(
  ${OGG_DIR}/include
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)

zephyr_library_sources(
  ${OGG_DIR}/src/bitwise.c
  ${OGG_DIR}/src/framing.c
)

endif() # CONFIG_OGG
